prompt: glibc printf_info width precision star arginfo function value
answer:
For `struct printf_info`:

| Format component | No `*` specified | With `*` in the handler | With `*` in the arginfo function |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `width` | `0` if omitted | Actual `int` value retrieved from the argument list | `INT_MIN` |
| `prec` | `-1` if omitted | Actual value retrieved from the argument list | `INT_MIN` |

The `arginfo` function should also describe each `*` argument as `PA_INT` in its `argtypes` array. Its prototype is:

```c
int function(const struct printf_info *info, size_t n, int *argtypes);
```

The handler prototype is:

```c
int function(FILE *stream, const struct printf_info *info,
             const void *const *args);
```

Sources: [Conversion Specifier Options](https://sourceware.org/glibc/manual/latest/html_node/Conversion-Specifier-Options.html), [Defining the Output Handler](https://www.sourceware.org/glibc/manual/latest/html_node/Defining-the-Output-Handler.html)
